title: Inventory: what changed and why
_comment: One investigative pass over both reports' evidence; a separate descriptive summary per report. Reports run SEQUENTIALLY in one process - get_powerbi_token() does an unlocked read-modify-write of the token cache, and insight_memory.commit_run takes a best-effort lock, so parallel jobs would race (Non-negotiable 2).
_datasets_differ: These two reports are in DIFFERENT semantic models. Chain memory is therefore stored at <root>/chains/inventory/memory.json with no dataset segment, or the one chain would resolve to two separate stores and share nothing. Story identities stay distinct per model because insight_memory.story_key includes the dataset.
